Business Scenario: Sign up and find work near home
What the user does (plain language): Open the app in Hindi, register with my phone number, and search for jobs near me
Expected Business Outcome: I can register easily in Hindi and see real jobs close to my location

Business Scenario: Apply for a job in one tap
What the user does (plain language): Open a job I like and apply
Expected Business Outcome: My application is sent without a long form; I can see it under 'My Applications'

What the user does (plain language): Wait for the employer to respond, then chat and see my interview
Expected Business Outcome: I get notified, can message the employer, and see my interview details

What the user does (plain language): Use the whole app end to end
Expected Business Outcome: I am never asked to pay for anything

Business Scenario: Use the app with minimal reading
What the user does (plain language): Complete registration and apply relying on icons/Hindi
Expected Business Outcome: I can complete the core journey without needing to read English or type much

Business Scenario: Register my business and get approved
What the user does (plain language): Sign up as a business, submit details, and wait for approval
Expected Business Outcome: I understand I need approval, and once approved I can start hiring

Business Scenario: Buy a plan and understand what I get
What the user does (plain language): Look at the plans and purchase one
Expected Business Outcome: Pricing (incl. GST) is clear; I know my posts/unlocks/seats; payment works; I get a GST invoice

Business Scenario: Post a job and receive applicants
What the user does (plain language): Post a job using the category picker and review who applies
Expected Business Outcome: Posting is quick; I can see and manage applicants

What the user does (plain language): Search the candidate database and unlock someone I like
Expected Business Outcome: I see previews for free, pay 1 credit only when I choose to unlock, and get their contact

What the user does (plain language): Schedule an interview and chat with a candidate
Expected Business Outcome: I can schedule an interview and communicate directly

What the user does (plain language): Check my wallet after posting/unlocking
Expected Business Outcome: My balance and expiry are clear and correct

What the user does (plain language): Invite a teammate and have them join my company workspace
Expected Business Outcome: My teammate joins and shares the same credits/jobs; I control who's on the team

What the user does (plain language): Download my invoice after buying
Expected Business Outcome: A correct GST invoice PDF is available

Business Scenario: Run the hiring journey in Hindi
What the user does (plain language): Switch to Hindi and hire
Expected Business Outcome: The whole employer journey works in Hindi

What the user does (plain language): Review a pending employer and approve them
Expected Business Outcome: Approval lets the employer post; the action is confirmed

What the user does (plain language): Review and verify/reject submitted documents
Expected Business Outcome: Verification updates the user's status correctly

What the user does (plain language): Handle a reported/suspicious post and resolve the report
Expected Business Outcome: I can warn/flag/remove and close the report with a note

What the user does (plain language): Open the dashboard
Expected Business Outcome: I see real payments received and trends I can trust

What the user does (plain language): Open monetization and check a payment/invoice
Expected Business Outcome: Amounts match exactly (to the paisa) for reconciliation

What the user does (plain language): Add/remove admin accounts
Expected Business Outcome: I can manage admins with the right guards (can't delete self/last super-admin)

What the user does (plain language): Report a bad job; check my data isn't misused
Expected Business Outcome: I can report; no Aadhaar is asked; I feel safe

What the user does (plain language): Confirm invoices, security, and that hiring feels trustworthy
Expected Business Outcome: Payments feel secure; invoices are compliant; the platform feels professional
